title: The Mind Palace
overview: To reach Jingshan, travelers need Ren Xiaosu's help. While surviving the harsh wasteland, Xiaosu unexpectedly accesses a mysterious palace within his mind for the first time.

title: Gratitude Mission
overview: Suspecting he has awakened a supernatural power, Ren Xiaosu receives a bizarre new mission from his mind palace: he must successfully collect 100 genuine "thank-yous."

title: Wolf Attack
overview: A dangerous wolf pack attacks, making everyone a target. Amid the chaos, a miraculous healing medicine is introduced, bringing both a ray of hope and new dangers.

title: New Target
overview: The band returns in terrible shape, plunging Ren Xiaosu into a fresh crisis. When Luo Xinyu makes her first appearance, Xiaosu finds himself targeted once again.

title: Journey Begins
overview: As the barrier authorities investigate superpowered people, Ren Xiaosu accepts the band's request to guide them. They officially depart for the dangerous Jingshan.

title: First Casualty
overview: The group enters the treacherous Jingshan area, facing threats at every turn. When a mysterious death occurs, everyone is left wondering who the real killer is.

title: Vanishing Dead
overview: Ren Xiaosu is filled with doubts as corpses vanish and warnings forbid the living from entering. He must decide whether to turn back or keep moving forward.

title: Survival Game
overview: Utilizing master-level wilderness survival skills, Ren Xiaosu fights to escape a deadly canyon. Cornered by danger, he begins a high-stakes survival game.

title: Secret Revealed
overview: The dynamic shifts as alliances are questioned. Xu Xianchu reveals a massive secret about Jingshan, forcing the group to choose between retreating or advancing.

title: Dream Danger
overview: Ren Xiaosu faces threats within his dreams as strange events plague the group. He unlocks a new ability just as they approach a mysterious, silent city ruin.

title: True Identity
overview: Yang Xiaojin's true identity is exposed, and the shadow of the Tinder Company looms. Meanwhile, the previously vanished corpses suddenly reappear, raising alarms.

title: Lost Ruins
overview: A new enemy emerges among the ruined city remnants. Dangerous monsters show up, throwing the group into chaos, and Yang Xiaojin mysteriously vanishes.

title: Midnight gunfire
overview: When the academy is attacked, Yan Liuyuan erupts with power to protect Sister Xiaoyu. It is revealed that teacher Zhang Jinglin is a major figure from the barrier.

title: The real intention
overview: The Tinder Company's secret base is exposed as Yang Xiaojin's true goals are questioned. In a shocking twist, Luo Xinyu is revealed to be a superhuman.

title: Seven Thanks
overview: Relentlessly pursued by the dangerous Qing clan, Ren Xiaosu faces mortal peril. Cornered, he decides to trigger his system by thanking himself seven times.

title: Escape Home
overview: Test subjects rampage and destroy the base. Xiaosu escapes home, but Barrier 113 faces its ultimate crisis, leaving their future survival entirely uncertain.
